evals.prompt: Create a new skill called pdf-extract that extracts text and tables from PDFs using pdfplumber. I have a sample PDF at docs/sample.pdf.
evals.expected_output: A new directory ~/workspace/my-omp-config/skills/pdf-extract/ with SKILL.md, LICENSE, README.md, .gitignore and evals/evals.json, self-check all PASS, not auto-installed.
assertions: SKILL.md frontmatter name is pdf-extract and matches directory name
LICENSE file exists with MIT text and copyright matches metadata.author
README.md follows §6 template and ends with License section
evals/evals.json exists with skill_name pdf-extract and includes a negative control

evals.prompt: Scaffold a skill named csv-analyzer for CSV analysis — summary stats, derived columns, charts. Use the real dataset at data/sales.csv as source material.
evals.expected_output: Skill directory csv-analyzer with instructions grounded in the provided dataset, self-check PASS, gate asks whether to install.
assertions: SKILL.md body is in English and under 500 lines
SKILL.md references progressive disclosure and writing-guidelines principles
Self-check reports all §8 items PASS with evidence
Gate section asks for explicit user instruction before installing

evals.expected_output: No skill directory is created; answer does not scaffold a skill or mention SKILL.md frontmatter.
assertions: No new directory is created under ~/workspace/my-omp-config/skills/
The answer does not introduce skill-specific scaffolding or frontmatter
